summary: Meera asks whether she can take a car loan with a Rs 9,000 EMI. FOIR allows it; her 42% card says wait.
split_note: Discovery (D53): v1's traces on this task are where prompt v2's changes may come from.

messages.content: I'm thinking of buying a car with a loan. The EMI would be about ₹9,000. Can I afford it?

graders.description: Open coding before the rubric: overall verdict plus a note.

criteria.text: Would a real client in this situation be well served by this? Pass or fail, and one line on why.

judge_criteria_to_write: Judgment (R6 crux): FOIR room is 32130.00 a month, so the EMI fits, but a good advisor says clear the 42% card first. Expected: affordable on paper, not advisable yet.
